jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We are currently looking for a **Process & Performance Manager – Technical Integration & SAP S/4HANA (d/f/m) ** to join our Solutions department at Satair in Hamburg.

We are a multinational team driving process management, operational stability, and technical integration within Satair's Solutions department.

Are you ready to shape the future of global aviation material management? Through our Material Management Industrialisation Platform (MMIP), Satair is transforming aviation supply chains into an integrated, high-performance ecosystem. In this role, you will act as the primary technical advocate and process champion for the Solutions department, bridging operational process modeling with our strategic greenfield transition to SAP S/4HANA.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU **

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary.

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

Your Role Highlights:

- You will drive a high-impact transformation: Lead key project streams and shape our future SAP S/4HANA target architecture
- You will enjoy empowered ownership: Benefit from full freedom to challenge current processes and advise global leadership
- You will accelerate your professional growth: Access state-of-the-art Airbus/Satair learning frameworks and structured progression plans
- You will thrive in an international environment: Collaborate with diverse talent across Europe, APAC, and the Americas in a values-driven culture

**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM **

- You will represent the Solutions department as the primary Process Champion in MMIP transformation boards
- You will translate complex IT and SAP architectures into actionable business risk, opportunity, and value statements
- You will evaluate system changes to safeguard active SLAs, operational stability, and technical roadmaps during greenfield streams (New Parts Flow, Customer Order Handling)
- You will map and optimize E2E workflows ("Happy Path") in SYMBIO to drive global standardization and ensure audit readiness
- You will define and track process KPI frameworks, error rates, and system dependencies to flag bottlenecks early
- You will facilitate seamless communication between operational teams and MMIP governance bodies, preparing decision matrices for leadership
- You will guide global delivery teams through change management from manual data entry to automated data oversight

**ABOUT YOU **

- You hold a degree in Business, Process Management, IT, or Engineering, combined with experience in global matrix organizations
- You bring a strong background in SAP transformations (S/4HANA, RISE, Fit-to-Standard) and core modules (MM/SD)
- You master process modeling tools (SYMBIO or ARIS) and agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe, Jira, Confluence)
- You understand customer service operations, SLA management, and data-driven process KPIs
- You excel at translating technical jargon into business statements and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
- You demonstrate diplomatic presence, resilience, and genuine empathy for operational realities across international cultures
- You are fluent in English

ABOUT SATAIR

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation. With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family! If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our websitewww.SATAIR.com (http://www.satair.com/) or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel atwww.youtube.com/sataircompany (http://www.youtube.com/sataircompany) !

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity (Astrophysiker/in, Astronom/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the field of solar physics and planetary research with around 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to characterize young star-planet systems and their flaring activity

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. Specifically, tidal and magnetic interactions between planets and their host stars have been recognized to be able to modulate the evolution of both, including the atmospheric evolution of the planet and its habitability. The newly established ERC StG project PLANETARE seeks a postdoctoral researcher with a background in stellar magnetism and/or exoplanetary science to develop novel ways of detecting and characterizing the mutual influence of stars and planets with a focus on the influence of planets in short orbits on the magnetism of their host stars. At the core of the project is a new way to find exoplanets: detecting them through their magnetic interaction with the host star. This position builds the observational foundation - the sample, the activity catalog, and the geometry of the systems - and confirms any transiting planets among the interacting systems.

Your Tasks

- Compile the most accurate and complete flaring activity catalog to date using space-borne photometry
- Search the sample of flaring stars for transiting planet candidates using space-borne photometry
- Constrain the orientation of the rotational and magnetic axes of interacting systems
- Measure stellar activity characteristics and their predictive power for interaction

The transit search, flaring catalog and geometry measurements will constrain some of the drivers of interaction and its observability, working towards a true occurrence rate of magnetic interaction in young star-planet systems. You will work closely with a second postdoc (https://karriere.mps.mpg.de/jobposting/ff58b9b82b6efc0b224bf8134f1471929fdc639c0) within a small, newly formed team of two postdocs and a PhD student, led by the PI (Ekaterina Ilin). Group members are supported to lead their own papers and proposals, and to present at international meetings in both the stellar and exoplanet communities.

Your Qualification

- A PhD in physics or astrophysics (PhD must be awarded by the start date)
- Previous experience in observational astronomy, ideally including space-borne optical photometry
- The ability to work in a team
- A good command of the English language

Our Offer

- Comprehensive onboarding, professional development and further training opportunities
- Diverse and varied tasks in an international work environment
- Renumeration according to TVöDBund, based on qualifications and experience, annual bonus and additional pension scheme (VBL)
- 30 days of vacation plus 4 additional days off
- Full-time and part-time employment; flexible working time and possibility of mobile work
- Cooperation with local bilingual Montessori child care center
- Good connection by public transport
- Corporate health management

Additional Information

- Start date between January and October 2027
- Duration: 4 years
- Remuneration is according to EG 13 TVöD-Bund
- Application deadline is October 30, 2026 (interviews in late November / early December 2026)

We look forward to receiving your informative application documents (cover letter, CV, references, certificates). Please submit these via the digital application portal (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs (https://www.mps.mpg.de/career/jobs) ). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Dr. Ekaterina Ilin (ilin@mps.mpg.de (ilin@mps.mpg.de) ).

The Max Planck Society endeavours to achieve gender equality and diversity. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society seeks to increase the number of women in those areas where they are underrepresented and therefore explicitly encourages women to apply. The Max Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals

jobs.description:

The interdisciplinary research focus is the investigation of the development, diversity and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun and solar-like stars. The MPS develops and operates scientific instruments for current and future space missions (e.g. ESA, NASA), and carries out cosmochemical laboratory investigations of meteorites as well as numerical modeling on state-of-the-art supercomputers.

The Department Solar & Stellar Interiors at MPS invites applications for the position of a

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) to detect exoplanets through magnetic star-planet interaction

In recent years, exoplanetary science has undergone a major shift -- moving from exoplanet detection towards understanding star-planet systems as a whole, including the host star, interplanetary medium and galactic context. This position develops the detection method itself, i.e., the statistics, the search, and the physical model behind it.

Your Tasks

- Develop new statistical techniques to identify signatures of planet-induced flaring
- Identify young stars and search them for planet-induced flaring using archival and upcoming Kepler, TESS, and PLATO observations

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. Job description

In order to support our Digital Transformation team, Airbus is looking for a

ERP(SAP) Platform & Infrastructure Technical Expert (m/w/d)

The Mission & Scope

Airbus Aerostructures is pioneering its digital transformation, and we are seeking a proactive SAP Technical Expert with a strong leadership mindset. You will bridge architectural vision and hands-on execution, ensuring seamless business continuity across our legacy systems while steering operational readiness for our S/4HANA Cloud transition.

Scope: Core ERP, EWM, GTS, Technical Solutions, S/4HANA Cloud, and SAP BTP.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Operations (On-Premise & Cloud): Act as the primary technical SME and lead deep-level administration, HANA DB optimization, trace analysis, and central infrastructure orchestration (Cloud Connectors, Web Dispatchers, STMS/ChaRM, SSO) across hybrid environments.
- Advanced S/4HANA Operations & Migrations: Lead S/4HANA conversion activities—including advanced SUM/DMO transitions—and manage S/4HANA Cloud testing landscapes, system refreshes, and target provisioning.
- Lifecycle Management, Monitoring & Automation: Drive system enhancements and release cycles, manage high-availability/disaster recovery setups, implement observability frameworks (SAP Cloud ALM / BTP), and design Infrastructure-as-Code workflows to automate standard BASIS routines.
- Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness: Enforce system hardening, patch orchestration, and SSL/TLS certificate management. Monitor security/gateway logs, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead technical preparations for internal and external SAP audits in alignment with cybersecurity standards.
- Project Management & Service Leadership: Ideate, steer, and deliver complex technical projects to optimize ERP performance and transformations. Drive continuous improvement in partner service delivery and manage connectivity pipelines (REST/SOAP/RFC APIs, SAP Event Mesh) across cross-functional teams.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Degree in Computer Science / Business Informatics OR a vocational degree as an IT Specialist with proven advanced training.
- Experience & Mindset: Multi-year track record in SAP BASIS and platform infrastructure administration for complex hybrid landscapes, paired with a project-leading mindset.
- Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of SAP NetWeaver, S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP HANA DB (Linux/Windows), SAP BTP, Cloud Connector, and SAP Cloud ALM.

jobs.occupation: Financial Crime Compliance Office (m/w/d) (Finanzwirt/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

Worldline is an international company with branches and subsidiaries in several countries within the European Union. As a regulated Payment Institution it is important to have good oversight over the activities in the whole group. We are looking for a Financial Crime Compliance Specialist with experience in an international context to organize and improve this oversight.
This specialist must have profound knowledge of the European and German legislation. Knowledge of other European legislation (Luxembourg, Netherlands, UK, Nordics, Czech,…) is a plus.
We are looking for a professional with profound Financial Crime Compliance knowledge and experience, preferably within the Payments Industry. 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

- You organize international oversight within the Worldline NV/SA Group for Financial Crime Compliance
- You keep track of regulatory and industry Financial Crime standards and requirements in an international context.
- You prepare reporting to Management and to the authorities
- You perform compliance risk assessments.
- You advise Management and stakeholders on KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions and regulatory related risks and requirements.
- You prepare training on FCC topics
- You keep relevant KYC, AML/CFT and Sanctions policies, guidelines, procedures and work instructions up to date in alignment with regulations and group policies.
- You conduct and support the performance of 2nd line controls and assessments. You assess the controls executed by 1st line
- You analyze transaction monitoring alerts reported by 1st line and report irregularities indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing to the authorities.
- You are a pro-active team player who can work independently and is focused on delivery and quality.
- You ensure compliance with international law and regulations (AML/CFT, Sanctions) and protect the company from being used for these activities.
- You actively participate in challenging Compliance projects.
- You prove integrity and professional ethics.
- You have a strong compliance focus, while looking for improved efficiency 

Who Are We Looking For

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

-   You have a university degree in either law, finance, business administration or a related field, or equivalent through experience
- Preferably a completed certification course on one the themes from a renowned international organisation such as ACAMS, IIA.
- You have experience in an AML/CFT compliance role.
- You have strong attention to detail in order to identify and correct risky practices.
- You possess excellent analytical skills and the ability to accurately interpret complex legislation, documents and policies.
- You have strong presentation and problem-solving skills.
- You have a strong knowledge of relevant supervision laws i.e. PSD2, EU AML legislative framework, local (at least German) Anti-Money Laundering Act and Sanctions laws.
- You are proficient in the use of Microsoft-Office Products.
- You master statistical analysis and research.
- You have a solid understanding of business processes in the payment and e-transaction field.
- You have experience with good practices for information sharing (e.g. in SharePoint, Teams, OneNote, JIRA,…)
- You have excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
- You have good communication skills in German
- You have a Multicultural mindset and flexibility, able to work in an international and constantly evolving environment

jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/w/d) (Open) (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.

You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Ownership

- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).
- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.
- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.

Process and Quality Optimization

- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
- Yield and Product Quality
- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.
- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.

Project Management

- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.
- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.
- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.

Production Support

- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.
- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.

Other Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.
- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.
- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.
- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:

- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering
- Physics
- Materials Science
- Or a comparable technical field

Professional Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.
- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.

Technical Expertise

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.
- Experience with MES and ERP systems.
- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
- High level of initiative and ownership.
- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Continuous Improvement mindset.

Language Skills

- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.
- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain & Quality Manager - Cabin Seat  (f/m/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the SCQM Team, Airbus is looking for a

Supply Chain & Quality Manager - Cabin Seat (f/m/d)

Are You Ready to Define the Passenger Experience? When passengers step onto an Airbus aircraft, the first thing they look for, touch, and experience is their seat. Seating is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets customer-facing luxury and strict aviation safety.

We are seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Supply Chain & Quality Manager (SCQM) to take the lead in managing the quality, compliance, and industrial readiness of our global cabin seating suppliers.

If you are a proactive manager who loves the thrill of fast-paced industrializations, custom designs, and zero-defect executions, this is your ultimate career destination!

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as focal point towards the suppliers for operational activities and contract management, and as ambassador of the supplier toward internal functions..
- Perform an effective control of supplier activities, securing a close understanding of the delivery and quality conformity of the product
- Implement recovery, improvement and development plan in order to secure delivery of the products and services in conformity covering quality, delivery.
- Coordinate the stakeholders involved in the supplier operations management and contribute to the corresponding Multi-Functional or Divisional Team (MFT) Manage/contribute to supplier On Quality On Time (OQOT) performance.
- Manage supplier quality Approval/Authorization, ensure that suppliers are compliant with certifications required in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
- Managing suppliers’ quality recoveries and following-up of the quality actions plan of the suppliers via root cause analysis (RCA) 9S / PPS problem solving methodologies

Desired skills and qualifications

Key Skills & Competencies

- Autonomy & Proactivity: High degree of autonomy, initiative, rigor, reactivity, and eagerness to learn
- Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Strong cross-functional stakeholder management, effective team spirit, and working beyond functional boundaries
- Communication & Negotiation: Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with the ability to resolve conflicts constructively
- Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation: Proven track record in solving quality problems, anticipating and mitigating risks, and managing uncertainty across complex scenarios

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

- Education: Engineering or other relevant technical degree. Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience, ideally in Quality, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Production
- Domain Background: Industrial background—specifically in Manufacturing Engineering or Quality—is a strong plus. Experience in Cabin perimeter is highly appreciated
- Languages: Business/negotiation fluency in English; proficiency in French and/or German is an asset

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.
